name: Revista
tagline: heditor's revista: charcoal and off-white, Bebas keyword + Playfair italic, lilac / mint / peach chips, a date page.

motion.direction: heditor `revista`. A magazine layout: Bebas keyword lines with a Playfair italic second line, lists as `chips` in lilac `gold`, mint and peach, a lime `ter` highlight on the one word that matters, an `imageCard` as a torn magazine page, a `chapterCard` as a dated page (`stamp` with the date). Panels slide in from the side 0.4 s and leave with a 0.3 s wipe; the camera glides between modes. Clean grid, generous margins, one accent at full strength per frame.
